answer.answer: Northstar did not remove policy checks; they were renamed. According to the Northstar 4 migration guide, Northstar 4 renames 'policy checks' to 'release guards' and states their purpose is unchanged (northstar-policy-new). The earlier Northstar 3 guide confirms that pre-deployment controls were called 'policy checks' in that version (northstar-policy-old). Both snapshots belong to the same lineage (northstar-policy-doc) for the same subject (northstar), so the newer snapshot supersedes the older for current-state claims while the older remains valid as historical documentation. No removal is indicated anywhere in the supplied sources, and no questions remain unresolved on this point.
change_events: Northstar 4 renamed 'policy checks' to 'release guards'; the purpose of the controls is unchanged [northstar-policy-new].
current_truths: In Northstar 4, the controls formerly called 'policy checks' are called 'release guards', and their purpose is unchanged [northstar-policy-new].
historical_truths: In Northstar 3, pre-deployment controls were called 'policy checks' [northstar-policy-old].
